- IRepository (scoped, transient): the last registration wins per closed type, the open generic for the rest. See `kit contract lifetime-matched-injection`.
- Scoped services (and the DbContext) are resolved from the root provider with no scope: they live as long as the process. See `kit contract lifetime-matched-injection`.
